# BACTERIA

Always consider disease or syndrome, site of infection, penetration of drug(s)

into site, and whether organism is pathogen, colonizer, or contaminant. See

disease/syndrome section for more information and treatment of pathogens not

listed below.

[Actinomyces spp.](orzid2-gmenu-gram-pos-fi-actinomyces-spp)
